decision: Keep rewrite_enabled=false. All twelve additional local calls echoed their input; this run found no search-quality gain. No answer generation or final-split inference was performed.
tradeoff: An extra provider call adds latency and another failure opportunity without observed benefit on these twelve queries. This does not establish behavior on all questions.
revisit: Only a separately declared development experiment with intent-preserving changes and actual retrieval benefit could justify further answer evaluation; no automatic promotion or repeat is authorized by this receipt.
label_limitations: Ten answerable questions use provisional, incomplete labels. Hit/MRR measure a retrieved labeled passage, not answer completeness; two unanswerable questions are excluded.
